spanish: Y vieron a Dios de Israel, y debajo de sus pies como obra de ladrillo del zafiro, y como hueso de los cielos a pureza.

findings.issue: Lemma 3840 (לִבְנַת) denotes whiteness/transparency, not brick; «ladrillo» adds a brick concept the token does not license.

notes: Remaining tokens match: 3mp qal saw, object marker, Dios de Israel, under his feet, like work of, the sapphire, and like bone of the heavens to purity.
